```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "hide")

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
has_input_file <- !is.null(input_file) &&
  length(input_file) > 0 &&
  !is.na(input_file) &&
  nzchar(input_file)

if (has_input_file) {
  input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
  project_dir <- if (basename(input_dir) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    normalizePath(input_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
  }
} else {
  cwd <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  project_dir <- if (basename(cwd) == "code") {
    normalizePath(file.path(cwd, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
  } else {
    cwd
  }
}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_dir)
setwd(project_dir)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tximport)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(WGCNA)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(Mfuzz)
  library(Biobase)
  library(scales)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(jsonlite)
})


options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
WGCNA::allowWGCNAThreads()

rdata_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "RData")
dir.create(rdata_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

rds_file <- function(name) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
}

cache_or_run <- function(name, expr, refresh = FALSE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (file.exists(path) && !refresh) {
    message("Loading cached object: ", path)
    readRDS(path)
  } else {
    message("Running and saving object: ", path)
    value <- force(expr)
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
  }
}

load_rds_object <- function(name, required = TRUE) {
  path <- rds_file(name)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    if (required) stop("Missing cached object: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  readRDS(path)
}

load_rds_list <- function(name, required = TRUE, envir = .GlobalEnv) {
  value <- load_rds_object(name, required = required)
  if (!is.null(value)) list2env(value, envir = envir)
  invisible(value)
}

analysis_file <- function(...) {
  file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
}

input_file_path <- function(...) {
  cached <- file.path(rdata_dir, ...)
  if (file.exists(cached)) return(cached)
  file.path(project_dir, ...)
}

show_table <- function(x, n = 20, title = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    cat("\n### ", title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No object available.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No rows.\n")
    return(invisible(df))
  }
  print(utils::head(df, n))
  invisible(df)
}

show_plot_files <- function(paths) {
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(paths) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  paths <- normalizePath(paths, mustWork = TRUE)
  knitr::include_graphics(paths)
}
```

```{r cache = FALSE}

sample_names <- c("CK-1", "CK-2", "CK-3", 
                  "Pt2d-1", "Pt2d-2", "Pt2d-3",
                  "Pt5d-1", "Pt5d-2", "Pt5d-3",
                  "Pt8d-1", "Pt8d-2", "Pt8d-3")

quant_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "02_quant_real")
files <- file.path(quant_dir, paste0(sample_names, "_quant"), "quant.sf")
names(files) <- sample_names
missing_files <- files[!file.exists(files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("Missing Salmon quant.sf files:\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"))
}

deseq_lrt <- cache_or_run("01_deseq_lrt", {
  txi <- tximport(files, type = "salmon", txOut = TRUE)
  sample_info <- data.frame(
    row.names = sample_names,
    time = factor(rep(c("0d", "2d", "5d", "8d"), each = 3),
                  levels = c("0d", "2d", "5d", "8d"))
  )
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, colData = sample_info, design = ~ time)
  keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
  dds <- dds[keep, ]
  dds <- DESeq(dds, test = "LRT", reduced = ~ 1)
  list(txi = txi, sample_info = sample_info, dds = dds, res = results(dds))
})
list2env(deseq_lrt, envir = .GlobalEnv)
```

```{r}
sig_objects <- cache_or_run("02_significant_nlr", {
  sig_res <- subset(res, padj < 0.05)
  nlr_list <- read.table("gene.list", header = FALSE)$V1
  sig_nlr_res <- sig_res[rownames(sig_res) %in% nlr_list, ]
  list(sig_res = sig_res, nlr_list = nlr_list, sig_nlr_res = sig_nlr_res)
})
list2env(sig_objects, envir = .GlobalEnv)
```

```{r}

mfuzz_objects <- cache_or_run("04_mfuzz_clusters", {
  time_0d <- rowMeans(nlr_expr_matrix[, 1:3])
  time_2d <- rowMeans(nlr_expr_matrix[, 4:6])
  time_5d <- rowMeans(nlr_expr_matrix[, 7:9])
  time_8d <- rowMeans(nlr_expr_matrix[, 10:12])
  nlr_mean_matrix <- cbind(time_0d, time_2d, time_5d, time_8d)

  eset <- new("ExpressionSet", exprs = nlr_mean_matrix)
  eset <- standardise(eset)
  m <- mestimate(eset)

  cluster_num <- 4
  cl <- mfuzz(eset, c = cluster_num, m = m)

  cluster_name_map <- c(
    "1" = "C1_Early_transient_up",
    "2" = "C2_Gradual_decline",
    "3" = "C3_Early_peak_late_drop",
    "4" = "C4_Late_up"
  )

  cluster_results <- data.frame(
    Gene = rownames(nlr_mean_matrix),
    Cluster_id = cl$cluster,
    Cluster = cluster_name_map[as.character(cl$cluster)]
  )
  write.csv(cluster_results, analysis_file("NLR_Mfuzz_clusters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  list(
    nlr_mean_matrix = nlr_mean_matrix,
    eset = eset,
    m = m,
    cluster_num = cluster_num,
    cl = cl,
    cluster_name_map = cluster_name_map,
    cluster_results = cluster_results
  )
})
list2env(mfuzz_objects, envir = .GlobalEnv)
mfuzz.plot2(eset, cl, mfrow = c(2, 2), time.labels = c("0d", "2d", "5d", "8d"))
print(round(cl$centers, 3))
```

```{r}

plot_data <- as.data.frame(exprs(eset)) %>%
  mutate(Gene = rownames(.), 
         Cluster = factor(
           cluster_name_map[as.character(cl$cluster)],
           levels = c("C1_Early_transient_up",
                      "C4_Late_up",
                      "C3_Early_peak_late_drop",
                      "C2_Gradual_decline")
         )) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Gene, Cluster), 
               names_to = "Time", 
               values_to = "Expression")

plot_data$Time <- factor(plot_data$Time, levels = c("time_0d", "time_2d", "time_5d", "time_8d"))


cluster_cores <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Cluster, Time) %>%
  summarise(Core_Exp = mean(Expression), .groups = 'drop')

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = plot_data, 
            aes(x = Time, y = Expression, group = Gene), 
            color = "grey80", alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = cluster_cores, 
            aes(x = Time, y = Core_Exp, group = Cluster, color = Cluster), 
            linewidth = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Cluster, scales = "fixed") + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "NLR Gene Expression Clusters (Mfuzz)",
       subtitle = "Grey lines: individual genes; Colored lines: cluster mean",
       x = "Time Point", 
       y = "Standardized Expression") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        legend.position = "none")


p
```

```{r cache = FALSE}
annotation_bg <- cache_or_run("07_annotation_background", {
  anno <- read_tsv("Pt_annotation.emapper.annotations", comment = "##")
  colnames(anno)[1] <- "Gene"
  gene2go <- anno %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, GOs) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(GOs) & GOs != "-") %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(GOs, sep = ",") %>%
  dplyr::select(GOs, Gene)

gene2kegg <- anno %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, KEGG_Pathway) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(KEGG_Pathway) & KEGG_Pathway != "-") %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(KEGG_Pathway, sep = ",") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pathway = str_extract(KEGG_Pathway, "ko[0-9]+")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Pathway)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Pathway, Gene)

  list(anno = anno, gene2go = gene2go, gene2kegg = gene2kegg)
})
list2env(annotation_bg, envir = .GlobalEnv)
print(paste("Extracted GO rows:", nrow(gene2go), "rows; KEGG rows:", nrow(gene2kegg), "rows"))
```

```{r cache = FALSE}
obo_local <- "go-basic.obo"

parse_go_obo <- function(path) {
  obo_lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  term_start <- which(obo_lines == "[Term]")
  term_end <- c(term_start[-1] - 1, length(obo_lines))

  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(term_start), function(i) {
    block <- obo_lines[term_start[i]:term_end[i]]
    id <- sub("^id: ", "", block[grepl("^id: ", block)][1])
    name <- sub("^name: ", "", block[grepl("^name: ", block)][1])
    namespace <- sub("^namespace: ", "", block[grepl("^namespace: ", block)][1])
    obsolete <- any(block == "is_obsolete: true")

    if (is.na(id) || is.na(name)) return(tibble())
    tibble(
      GOID = id,
      TERM = name,
      Obsolete = obsolete,
      ONTOLOGY = recode(
        namespace,
        biological_process = "BP",
        molecular_function = "MF",
        cellular_component = "CC",
        .default = NA_character_
      )
    )
  })
}

go_obo_tbl <- parse_go_obo(obo_local)
go2name_full <- go_obo_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(TERM), TERM != "")
go2name <- go2name_full %>%
  dplyr::select(GOID, TERM)
go2ontology <- go_obo_tbl %>%
  dplyr::select(GOID, ONTOLOGY)
```
